questions.q: A green school is a school where we…
questions.a: manage waste, save water, use electricity carefully and plant trees
questions.e: Aasha’s brother explained what a green school is.

questions.q: Swachh Bharat Swachh Vidyalaya focuses on…
questions.a: clean toilets, safe drinking water, waste management and hygiene in schools
questions.e: Every child has the right to a clean and safe school.

questions.q: Which village in Meghalaya is called ‘Asia’s Cleanest Village’?
questions.a: Mawlynnong
questions.e: It is celebrated for its cleanliness.

questions.q: Which School Explorer Team checks “{x}”?
pairs: vehicles and crossings at the gate
questions.e: That is the job of the {ans}.

pairs: vehicles and crossings at the gate
questions.e: That is the job of the {ans}.

questions.q: Which School Explorer Team checks “{x}”?
pairs: vehicles and crossings at the gate
questions.e: That is the job of the {ans}.

questions.q: Why should water tanks at school be clean and covered?
questions.a: To keep water safe and stop mosquitoes breeding
questions.e: Water watchers also look for wet places where mosquitoes can breed.

questions.q: Food peels and leftovers are…
questions.a: wet waste
questions.e: Separate waste into wet and dry to manage it better.

questions.q: In the segregation game, the green box is for…
questions.a: wet waste
questions.e: Green for wet, blue for dry, and a third box for the recycler.

questions.q: Old newspapers are usually…
questions.a: kept aside and given to recyclers
w: put in the wet waste bin
questions.e: Different recyclers collect different items.

questions.q: Where should {x} go?
questions.e: {x} → {ans}.

questions.q: Where should {x} go?
questions.e: {x} → {ans}.

questions.q: Where should {x} go?
questions.e: {x} → {ans}.

questions.q: What happens if we do not separate our waste?
questions.a: It is harder to manage, recycle and keep our surroundings clean
questions.e: Separating wet and dry waste helps recycling and composting.

questions.q: We can reduce waste by…
questions.a: using only what we need, reusing things and not throwing away useful items
questions.e: Reduce and reuse come first.

questions.q: Which roof colour keeps a building cooler?
questions.a: White
questions.e: White reflects the Sun’s heat; black absorbs heat.

questions.q: In Activity 3, a black tile and a white tile are kept in the Sun. Which feels cooler?
questions.a: The white tile
questions.e: A white surface reflects heat.

questions.q: What helps keep classrooms cool?
questions.a: Shady trees and windows that let the breeze in
questions.e: Trees and breeze make a difference.

questions.q: Clay pots (matkas) keep drinking water cool…
questions.a: without using electricity
questions.e: A smart design!

questions.q: A glass of water is kept under a tree and another in the Sun for an hour. What will you find?
questions.a: The water under the tree is cooler
w: The water in the Sun is cooler
The water under the tree freezes
questions.e: Trees give shade and keep surroundings cool.

questions.q: Trees help us by…
questions.a: cleaning the air, giving shade and food for birds and insects
questions.e: Trees are home to many living beings.

questions.q: In Ladakh, students make ‘ice stupas’. What are they used for?
questions.a: They slowly melt in summer to water school gardens
questions.e: A clever way to store water as ice.

questions.q: The Jal Shakti Abhiyan encourages people to…
questions.a: plant trees, catch rainwater and use water wisely
questions.e: Schools can help by fixing leaks and collecting rainwater.

questions.q: During a fire drill, you should…
questions.a: move calmly to the nearest exit without running
questions.e: Then go to the assembly point and stay with your group.

questions.q: Why should you crawl low under smoke?
questions.a: The air near the floor is cleaner to breathe
w: Smoke is heavy and stays on the floor
questions.e: Cover your mouth and crawl low.

questions.q: Once you are outside during a fire, you should…
questions.a: never go back into the building
w: go back to get your books
questions.e: Alert teachers if anyone is missing or injured.

questions.q: Many road accidents happen because…
questions.a: people do not follow traffic rules
questions.e: Knowing and following traffic rules keeps us safe.

questions.q: Two students are pushing and skipping the line at the water tap. What is the kind thing to do?
questions.a: Politely remind them to wait for their turn
questions.e: Respect is shown by waiting for our turn.

questions.q: Which action shows kindness at school?
questions.a: Helping a shy classmate feel included
questions.e: When we are kind and polite, everyone feels happy.

questions.q: A dripping tap fills one glass in {m} minutes. How many glasses of water are wasted in one day (24 hours)?
questions.e: 1 day = 24 × 60 = 1,440 minutes. 1,440 ÷ {m} = {ans} glasses!

questions.q: A dripping tap fills a 200 ml glass every {m} minutes. How many litres are wasted in a day? (1 litre = 1,000 ml)
questions.e: {g} glasses × 200 ml = {ml} ml = {ans} litres.

questions.q: Which set is sorted correctly?
questions.a: Wet: banana peel, leftover rice · Dry: chips packet, paper cup · Recycler: newspapers
w: Wet: newspapers · Dry: banana peel · Recycler: leftover rice
Wet: chips packet · Dry: leftover rice · Recycler: banana peel
questions.e: Food waste is wet, packets and cups are dry, newspapers go to the recycler.

questions.q: Your area is getting warmer every summer. Which plan will cool it best?
questions.a: Plant shady trees, paint roofs white and let breeze in
questions.e: Trees give shade; white reflects heat; breeze cools rooms.

questions.q: Put the fire drill in order.
questions.a: Move calmly to the exit → crawl low under smoke → go to the assembly point → tell teachers if anyone is missing
w: Hide in the bathroom → wait → go back for your bag
Run fast → push others → go home
Go to the assembly point → go back inside → look for friends
questions.e: Never hide and never go back into the building.

questions.q: Aasha wants to make her school greener. Which is the best first step?
questions.a: Walk around, make a map and observe what needs improving
questions.e: Explore first, then decide what to do.

questions.q: Why should lights and fans be switched off in empty classrooms?
questions.a: To save electricity
questions.e: Electricity savers check this.

questions.q: Why should we value recyclers and sanitation workers?
questions.a: They keep our surroundings clean and help reuse materials
questions.e: Respecting their work teaches the dignity of labour.

questions.q: What could you put on a signboard at the school gate?
questions.a: ‘Slow down – children crossing’
questions.e: Signboards help make the area safer for students.

questions.q: A younger student copies an older one throwing a wrapper. What does this show?
questions.a: Our behaviour sets an example for others
w: Wrappers are good for the playground
questions.e: The way we behave matters – others learn from us.
